title: PrecisionTimeIntervalType
description: A time interval with attosecond precision. Stores seconds and attoseconds as unsigned integers with an explicit sign, avoiding floating-point precision loss over large spans.

seconds.description: The whole-seconds component of the interval (unsigned).

attoseconds.description: The sub-second component in attoseconds (10^-18 s). Valid range: 0 to 999_999_999_999_999_999.

sign.description: The sign of the time interval.
